title: 2 Chronicles 3
paragraphs: ¹ Solomon began building the house of the LORD in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD had appeared to his father David, at the place David had prepared on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite. ² He began building on the second day of the second month in the fourth year of his reign. ³ These were the foundations Solomon laid for building the house of God: the length was sixty cubits by the older standard, and the width was twenty cubits. ⁴ The porch at the front of the temple was twenty cubits wide, matching the width of the building, and twenty cubits high, and he overlaid it on the inside with pure gold. ⁵ The main hall he paneled with pine and covered it with fine gold, decorating it with palm trees and interwoven chains.

⁶ He adorned the temple with precious stones for beauty, and the gold he used was gold from Parvaim. ⁷ He overlaid the beams, thresholds, walls, and doors of the temple with gold, and carved cherubim on the walls. ⁸ He built the Most Holy Place, which was twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide — matching the width of the temple — and he covered it with six hundred talents of fine gold. ⁹ The gold nails weighed fifty shekels. He also covered the upper rooms with gold. ¹⁰ In the Most Holy Place he made two sculptured cherubim and overlaid them with gold.

¹¹ The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits in total span: one wing of the first cherub was five cubits long, reaching to the wall of the temple, while the other wing was five cubits long, reaching to the wing of the second cherub. ¹² One wing of the second cherub was five cubits, reaching to the other wall, and the other wing was also five cubits, meeting the wing of the first cherub. ¹³ The wings of these cherubim spread out twenty cubits altogether. They stood upright, facing the main hall. ¹⁴ He made the curtain of blue, purple, and crimson yarn and fine linen, and embroidered cherubim on it. ¹⁵ In front of the temple he erected two pillars thirty-five cubits tall, with a capital of five cubits on top of each.

¹⁶ He made interwoven chains and put them on top of the pillars, and he made a hundred pomegranates and fastened them to the chains. ¹⁷ He set up the pillars in front of the temple — one on the south side and one on the north — and named the one on the south Jachin and the one on the north Boaz.
